description: CloudEvents 1.0 feed of construction signals, oldest first after since_id: daily permit aggregate cells (with gate B accuracy), newly published works tenders (AAO), laws coming up. Continue with next_since_id. Read-only aggregates: no permit rows, publication identifiers, titles, addresses, points or names; permit counts below 5 per authority per kind are shown as <5 and totals that would reveal one are lower bounds (>=n). Every answer carries source provenance (source, source_url, licence, as_of/retrieved_at, method, status) and an exposure block.
